(function () {
    // The A/B bucket has to be read from the cookie here, in the browser -- not passed in from
    // the server -- so that this script's presence/content never depends on a per-visitor value.
    // ?testName= mirrors espn-userab-utils's own QA override, read the same way it prioritizes it.
    var queryMatch = /[?&]testName=([^&]*)/.exec(window.location.search);
    var cookieMatch = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )userab_1=([^;]*)/);
    var userab;
    try {
        if (queryMatch) {
            userab = decodeURIComponent(queryMatch[1]);
        } else if (cookieMatch) {
            userab = decodeURIComponent(cookieMatch[1]);
        } else {
            userab = '';
        }
    } catch (e) {
        userab = '';
    }
    var bucketed =
        false || /dark_mode_device_detect-/.test(userab);

    if (!bucketed) {
        return;
    }

    var prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    var body = document.body;
    body.classList.remove('theme.light', 'theme.dark');
    body.classList.add(prefersDark ? 'theme.dark' : 'theme.light');
})();
</script>
